name: Baglioni Resort Sardinia
positioning: Resort on Sardinia's northeast coast, set within the Tavolara Marine Reserve a short distance from Lu Impostu beach, with garden verandas, a spa and a kids club
best_for: Families wanting a kids club and connecting-bedroom rooms
Couples wanting a spa couples' room and rooftop sea-view suites
Active travelers interested in diving, horseback riding, canyoning and golf nearby

facts.text: The resort is located on Sardinia's northeast coast.
The rooms have spacious verandas with private gardens.
The Grand Deluxe Room (Garden View) has Orosei stone flooring.
The 2-Bedroom Family Room has two connecting bedrooms, two bathrooms and a private veranda with garden.
The Sunset Terrace is a rooftop terrace above the Pool Bar for sunset aperitifs with the sea on the horizon.
Aura Spa has a steam room, a sauna and a cooling ice fountain.
The Garden Suite includes daily breakfast at the restaurant and guaranteed beach access with an umbrella.
Guests can play golf at Puntaldia Golf Club.
Guests can take a cooking class with the chefs of the resort's restaurant Gusto by Sadler.
The resort's experiences include diving and snorkeling in Tavolara.
The resort's experiences include a Sardinia helicopter tour.
The resort's experiences include canyoning on Rio Pitrisconi.

highlights.text: The resort is set within the Tavolara Marine Reserve, a short distance from Lu Impostu beach.
Guided horseback rides go along La Cinta beach and lagoon at dawn or sunset.
The Rooftop Terrace Suite has a rooftop terrace with 360-degree sea views.
Aura Spa has a couples' treatment room; after the massage, couples can soak in the hot tub and have an aperitivo.
The Baglioni Kids Club offers young guests sports, games, arts and crafts and entertainment.

considerations.text: The official site describes Lu Impostu beach as a short distance from the resort.
Aura Spa is open to people not staying at the resort as well as to hotel guests.
WhataHotel notes that the island location requires additional travel planning.
